features.name: Fighting Style: Interception
features.description: When a creature you can see hits a target, other than you, within 5 feet of you with an attack, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage the target takes by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus (to a minimum of 0 damage). You must be wielding a shield or a simple or martial weapon to use this reaction.

payload.name: Interception
payload.description: Reduce damage to an ally within 5 feet by 1d10 + proficiency bonus. Must be wielding a shield or simple/martial weapon.
